subject: This Month's Wellness Tips: 5 Ways to Boost Your Energy!
bodyText:
Hi there,

Check out this month's top wellness tips from our team:

1. Stay hydrated - aim for 8 glasses of water a day!
2. Get moving - even a 10-minute walk can boost your mood.
3. Prioritize sleep - 7-9 hours is the sweet spot for most adults.
4. Try a new healthy recipe this week - see our featured smoothie bowl below.
5. Take a screen break every hour.

Don't forget to follow us on social media for daily tips and community stories!
